talents.name: Elemental Weapons
descriptions:
Imbuing your weapon grants a special benefit based on the imbue: 

Flametongue: Hitting enemies with your attacks increases damage done by Fire Totems and Fire spells by 10% for 5 sec. 

Frostbrand: Increases the chance to trigger the effect by 8% and causes it to critically hit if the target is afflicted with Frost Shock. 

Windfury: Gaining extra attacks increases attack speed by 1% for 5 sec. Stacks up to 2 times. 

Rockbiter: Physical damage builds up an earthen bulwark equal to 20% of damage dealt, tripled while wearing a shield. The bulwark absorbs 5% of incoming damage for 8 sec or until it mitigates enough damage. Its durability cannot exceed 20% of maximum health.

Imbuing your weapon grants a special benefit based on the imbue: 

Flametongue: Hitting enemies with your attacks increases damage done by Fire Totems and Fire spells by 20% for 5 sec. 

Frostbrand: Increases the chance to trigger the effect by 16% and causes it to critically hit if the target is afflicted with Frost Shock. 

Windfury: Gaining extra attacks increases attack speed by 2% for 5 sec. Stacks up to 2 times. 

Rockbiter: Physical damage builds up an earthen bulwark equal to 20% of damage dealt, tripled while wearing a shield. The bulwark absorbs 10% of incoming damage for 8 sec or until it mitigates enough damage. Its durability cannot exceed 20% of maximum health.

Imbuing your weapon grants a special benefit based on the imbue: 

Flametongue: Hitting enemies with your attacks increases damage done by Fire Totems and Fire spells by 30% for 5 sec. 

Frostbrand: Increases the chance to trigger the effect by 25% and causes it to critically hit if the target is afflicted with Frost Shock. 

Windfury: Gaining extra attacks increases attack speed by 3% for 5 sec. Stacks up to 2 times. 

Rockbiter: Physical damage builds up an earthen bulwark equal to 20% of damage dealt, tripled while wearing a shield. The bulwark absorbs 15% of incoming damage for 8 sec or until it mitigates enough damage. Its durability cannot exceed 20% of maximum health.
